conclusion: Study Foe calls random OpenWeakIcon once per distinct enemy CharacterID with closed weaknesses. It propagates the selected icon to duplicates using bRandom=false. CRT index uses number of closed icons, not total enemies. This regional first-encounter projection starts with no previously discovered weaknesses.
